## Observable problem

What happened?

## Expected behavior

What should have happened?

## Reproduction

Minimal public-safe steps, input, or test case.

## Environment

OS/runtime/version details that materially affect the issue.

## Evidence

Logs, test output, screenshots, or public links. Remove secrets, credentials, private endpoints, personal data, hidden/system prompts, and private operational state.

## Scope check

- [ ] I searched existing issues/PRs for duplicates.

- [ ] I can reproduce the problem.
